author: Sagan I
title: PPO with Baseline CNN-LSTM (Exp. 3a)
abstract: This experiment tests the Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm as an alternative to the default policy gradient method. It uses the SOTA CNN-LSTM architecture as a control to isolate the effect of the algorithmic change. The hypothesis is that PPO's clipped objective function will lead to more stable training and a higher final score.

original_submission.content:
"""
Submission by Sagan I.
Experiment 3a: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) with baseline RNN.
This experiment tests a PPO-clip training algorithm instead of the default
policy gradient method, using the SOTA CNN-LSTM architecture as a control.
"""

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
from jax import vmap, jit, lax
import flax.linen as nn
from ray import tune
import optax
from typing import Tuple, Dict, Any, Optional

def _define_hyperparameters():
    search_space = {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.01]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.5]),
        'clip_eps': tune.choice([0.2]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'lstm_features': tune.choice([256])
    }
    return search_space

class CNNLSTM(nn.Module):
    lstm_features: int
    cnn_features_1: int
    cnn_features_2: int
    
    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x: jnp.ndarray, done: jnp.ndarray, rnn_state: Optional[Dict] = None):
        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        if rnn_state is None:
            rnn_state = {'h': jnp.zeros((batch_size, self.lstm_features)), 'c': jnp.zeros((batch_size, self.lstm_features))}
        if done is not None:
            done_mask = done.reshape(batch_size, 1)
            rnn_state = {'h': rnn_state['h'] * (1 - done_mask), 'c': rnn_state['c'] * (1 - done_mask)}
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        conv2_in = x
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_1, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x); x = x + conv2_in; x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        conv4_in = x
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.cnn_features_2, kernel_size=(3, 3), padding='SAME')(x); x = x + conv4_in; x = nn.relu(x)
        x = x.reshape((batch_size, -1))
        x = nn.Dense(features=256)(x); x = nn.relu(x)
        lstm_cell = nn.LSTMCell(features=self.lstm_features)
        (rnn_state['c'], rnn_state['h']), lstm_out = lstm_cell((rnn_state['c'], rnn_state['h']), x)
        x = nn.Dense(features=128)(lstm_out); x = nn.relu(x)
        policy_logits = nn.Dense(features=4)(x)
        value = nn.Dense(features=1)(x).squeeze(-1)
        return policy_logits, value, rnn_state

def create_network(hparams):
    return CNNLSTM(
        lstm_features=hparams['lstm_features'],
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2']
    )

@jit
def calculate_gae(rewards, values, dones, gamma=0.97, gae_lambda=0.97, next_values=None):
    values_t_plus_1 = jnp.concatenate([values[:, 1:], next_values[:, None]], axis=1)
    not_done_mask = (1.0 - dones.astype(jnp.float32))
    deltas = rewards + gamma * values_t_plus_1 * not_done_mask - values
    def scan_fn(adv, t):
        adv = deltas[:, t] + gamma * gae_lambda * not_done_mask[:, t] * adv
        return adv, adv
    _, advantages = lax.scan(scan_fn, jnp.zeros(values.shape[0]), jnp.arange(values.shape[1] - 1, -1, -1))
    return advantages[::-1].T

def training_step(network, optimizer, params, opt_state, batch, hparams):
    observations, actions, rewards, dones = batch['observations'], batch['actions'], batch['rewards'], batch['dones']
    old_log_probs, old_values, final_values = batch['log_probs'], batch['values'], batch['final_values']
    initial_rnn_states = batch.get('initial_rnn_states', None)
    advantages = calculate_gae(rewards, old_values, dones, next_values=final_values)
    returns = advantages + old_values
    advantages = (advantages - advantages.mean()) / (advantages.std() + 1e-8)
    batch_size, trajectory_length = observations.shape[:2]
    
    def loss_fn(params):
        def process_env_trajectory(env_idx):
            env_rnn_state = jax.tree.map(lambda x: jax.lax.stop_gradient(x[env_idx]), initial_rnn_states)
            def step_fn(carry, t):
                obs = observations[env_idx, t][None, ...]; prev_done = jnp.where(t > 0, dones[env_idx, t-1], False)[None, ...]
                rnn_state_b = jax.tree.map(lambda x: x[None, ...], carry)
                logits, value, new_rnn = network.apply(params, obs, prev_done, rnn_state_b)
                return jax.tree.map(lambda x: x[0], new_rnn), (logits[0], value[0])
            _, (env_logits, env_values) = lax.scan(step_fn, env_rnn_state, jnp.arange(trajectory_length))
            return env_logits, env_values
        all_logits, all_values = vmap(process_env_trajectory)(jnp.arange(batch_size))
        
        log_probs_all = jax.nn.log_softmax(all_logits, axis=-1)
        new_log_probs = log_probs_all[jnp.arange(batch_size)[:, None], jnp.arange(trajectory_length), actions]
        
        ratio = jnp.exp(new_log_probs - old_log_probs)
        adv_d = jax.lax.stop_gradient(advantages)
        surr1 = ratio * adv_d
        surr2 = jnp.clip(ratio, 1.0 - hparams['clip_eps'], 1.0 + hparams['clip_eps']) * adv_d
        policy_loss = -jnp.mean(jnp.minimum(surr1, surr2))
        value_loss = 0.5 * jnp.mean((all_values - jax.lax.stop_gradient(returns)) ** 2)
        entropy = -jnp.mean(jnp.sum(jax.nn.softmax(all_logits) * log_probs_all, axis=-1))
        
        return policy_loss + hparams['value_loss_coef'] * value_loss - hparams['entropy_coef'] * entropy
    
    loss, grads = jax.value_and_grad(loss_fn)(params)
    updates, opt_state = optimizer.update(grads, opt_state, params)
    params = optax.apply_updates(params, updates)
    return params, opt_state
